source: Core distinction. Dense ZXNAME0000XZ is an exact attention algorithm: it does not replace softmax attention with a low-rank, sparse, kernelized, or approximate formula. “Exact” refers to the mathematical attention computation. Floating-point kernels can still differ by small rounding effects because operations are reordered.[4, 10, 13]
zh: 核心区别。 Dense ZXNAME0000XZ 是一种精确注意力算法：它不会用低秩、稀疏、核化或近似公式取代 softmax 注意力。 “精确”指的是数学注意力计算。由于操作被重新排序，浮点内核仍然可能因较小的舍入效应而有所不同。[4,10,13]
